details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (headline financial performance), K2 (segment performance), K3 (warehouse automation), K4 (retail expansion), K5 (own brand development), and K9 (post-reporting events). However, it omits the liquidity position details required by K6, brand awareness metrics required by K7, and strategic focus areas required by K8. These omissions are material because they represent distinct HIGH-importance components of the overall financial report. While the summary captures most of the financial and operational highlights, the absence of liquidity, brand awareness, and strategic focus information prevents it from achieving full coverage.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected without contradictions. The narrative flows from revenue growth to profitability challenges, strategic investments, cash flow improvements, and future plans. Explanations for performance changes (e.g., investments causing margin contraction) are consistent. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the organization clearly groups related topics (financial performance, strategic actions, future outlook). Segment figures are presented without implying they should arithmetically reconcile to the total, avoiding any false contradiction. All elements work together to form a unified, logical summary.
